title: Snap Salat masjid registry entry
description: One masjid whose prayer times can be updated from the Snap Salat app. File path: registry/masajid/<country>/<region>/<city>/<masjid>.json, all lowercase slugs.

name.description: Masjid name as people know it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US, GB, PK.

area.description: Optional neighbourhood or district, to tell apart masajid in big cities.

api.description: Base URL of the Snap Salat API (see docs/api.md). Must be HTTPS.

display.description: Optional hints about the masjid's display so the app guesses less.

order.description: Reading order of the prayer clocks.

current_time_clock.description: Whether the board has a bigger clock showing the current time.

maintainers.description: GitHub usernames who may update this entry.
